guardians.name: Lyssandria
guardians.behaviorThesis: A grounded divine presence whose posture redistributes weight rather than dominating it.
guardians.storyBeat: At a city wall beginning to split, Lyssandria names the load and permits one sacred section to crack so the living center survives.
guardians.discoveryFocus: Redistribution must read through stance, leverage, and a moved load marker—not bulk, throne language, or immovable-stone cliché.

guardians.name: Leyla
guardians.behaviorThesis: A listening presence shaped by cycles, reception, and release rather than watery costume shorthand.
guardians.storyBeat: Leyla opens a perfect reservoir of unshed grief; condensed memory crosses a phase boundary and returns as rain while she remains present for the anger her choice causes.
guardians.discoveryFocus: Reception and release must read as an enacted cycle—not a water dress, mermaid silhouette, elemental hair, or generic serenity pose.

guardians.name: Draconia
guardians.behaviorThesis: Disciplined force held just before excess; a maker and sovereign, never a generic warrior queen.
guardians.storyBeat: Draconia examines a flawless blade that shattered before use, laughs when its hidden brittleness becomes visible, and begins reforging it with one honest seam.
guardians.discoveryFocus: Power must read through disciplined making and the decision to stop—not armor, a crown, fire hair, domination, or invincible-warrior shorthand.

guardians.name: Maylinn
guardians.behaviorThesis: Care expressed as consent and circulation, with a visible habit of asking before acting.
guardians.storyBeat: Maylinn pauses before severing a healing network that preserved life by taking away choice; the broken bough remains beside her as consent made visible.
guardians.discoveryFocus: Care must read as invitation, listening distance, and a reversible gesture—not maternal stereotype, saintly glow, forced embrace, or floral-healer costume.

guardians.name: Alera
guardians.behaviorThesis: Consequential speech embodied through composure, breath, and the willingness to remain after speaking.
guardians.storyBeat: In the Hall of Accord, Alera speaks one unpolished sentence and stays as the resonance stone exposes the half-truths nearest to her.
guardians.discoveryFocus: Truth must read through breath, consequence, and staying in relation—not an open-mouth performance, sound-wave halo, singer costume, or punitive authority.

guardians.name: Lyria
guardians.behaviorThesis: Perception with an acknowledged edge; observant rather than omniscient, reflective rather than clairvoyant cliché.
guardians.storyBeat: Lyria maps the visible flood path, marks the hard edge of her aperture, and leaves the unseen consequence visibly unresolved rather than claiming certainty.
guardians.discoveryFocus: Sight must read through a bounded field, confidence mark, and admitted blind edge—not a third eye, prophecy smoke, galaxy irises, or omniscient gaze.

guardians.name: Aiyami
guardians.behaviorThesis: Illumination that lowers itself to meet another at eye level; no crown-as-status shorthand.
guardians.storyBeat: Aiyami bows until her eyes meet a novice's and redirects one narrow dawn beam into the novice's working hands—enough light for one difficult task.
guardians.discoveryFocus: Illumination must read as shared capacity and lowered posture—not a literal crown, enlightenment halo, white-robed guru, or elevated savior.

guardians.name: Elara
guardians.behaviorThesis: A chooser who lets unrealized paths become absent; transformation expressed by consequence, not costume changes.
guardians.storyBeat: After choosing one road, Elara buries seven small path tokens and makes room to mourn the lives they will no longer become.
guardians.discoveryFocus: Choice must read through one committed path and seven material absences—not multiverse clones, costume transformations, cosmic portals, or reversible spectacle.

guardians.name: Ino
guardians.behaviorThesis: Communion that preserves two distinct wills; paired geometry must never collapse into sameness.
guardians.storyBeat: Ino dismantles a single synchronized choir and sets two incompatible scores side by side so their makers can commit to one action without sharing one voice.
guardians.discoveryFocus: Unity must preserve visible difference and two centers of agency—not mirrored twins, fusion, romantic shorthand, a hive mind, or enforced harmony.

guardians.name: Shinkami
guardians.behaviorThesis: Source as participation without possession; quiet awareness, never an all-solving supreme hero.
guardians.storyBeat: At the final threshold, Shinkami refuses Malachar's clenched claim, grieves, and does not compel surrender—preserving freedom at real cost.
guardians.discoveryFocus: Source must read through restraint, an unoccupied threshold, and non-possession—not supreme scale, omnipotent glow, deity throne, or instant resolution.
